svg.text: Real output captured from the session-lifecycle NixOS VM test (nix build .#e2e.session-lifecycle), 2026-10-15,
standard output and standard error together, as the test records them. The test runs nails from the Nix store,
which is why binary-location warns. The soft-reboot follows the last line.
